candidates.name: R2R-OFT
candidates.prior_positive_result: Quantized OpenVLA-OFT INT4 improves matched SmolVLA Base from 7/16 to 14/16 and from 3/8 to 6/8 on task 8.
candidates.prior_mechanism: OpenVLA-OFT LoRA fine-tuning with two images, proprioception, continuous L1 regression, LIBERO no-noop normalization, and 8-step 7D action chunks.
candidates.proposed_difference: Phase-balanced chunk imitation that upweights successful expert chunks where exactly one moka pot is already on/near the stove and the remaining moka pot still needs pickup/placement.
candidates.training_supervision: HDF5 expert action chunks plus training-only phase labels decoded from HDF5/simulator state or bounded replay.
candidates.key_ablation: same LoRA/QLoRA scaffold and task-8 data with uniform weights / m_t=0
candidates.simple_alternative: shorter OpenVLA-OFT action-chunk requery without training
candidates.second_backbone_path: same phase-weighted sampler/objective for SmolVLA adapter/QLoRA

candidates.name: MPC-OFT
candidates.prior_positive_result: Quantized OpenVLA-OFT INT4 improves matched SmolVLA Base but leaves two task-8 failures.
candidates.prior_mechanism: OpenVLA-OFT LoRA fine-tuning with continuous action chunks.
candidates.proposed_difference: Object-order and paraphrase augmentation for visually similar moka pots, emphasizing remaining-pot and left/right role variants during LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning.
candidates.training_supervision: HDF5 expert actions plus object identity/order labels if decodable.
candidates.key_ablation: same LoRA/QLoRA scaffold without counterfactual object-role augmentation

ours_candidate_generation.selection_rationale: R2R-OFT is the narrowest extension of the selected prior and directly targets the observed second-object residual phase; MPC-OFT adds a broader object-role augmentation hypothesis.
